Your library is one scan away.
Empty for now. Tell it where the music lives, or let it look.

scanError.permission: Mufify needs permission to read audio on this device.
scanError.generic: The scan stopped before it finished.
scanError.permissionBlocked: Permission is turned off for Mufify. Open system settings to allow audio access.

scanConfirm.title: Scan for music?
scanConfirm.body: Mufify will read every audio file Android has indexed on this device. On a large library this takes a while. You can stop it at any point, and anything already found is kept.

folderImportConfirm.title: Import this folder?
folderImportConfirm.body: Mufify will index the selected folder and read its tags. This can take a while on a large library and may temporarily affect device performance. You can stop it at any time.

importing.title: Importing music
messages: Reading the music that is already on this device.
Building the library without sending anything anywhere.
Covers and tags are being prepared for the library.

likedEmpty: No liked songs yet. Use the heart on a track to keep it here.

appearance.title: Appearance

language.title: Language
language.label: App language
language.description: Turkish and English. System follows your phone.

folders.title: Music folders
folders.empty: No folders added. Mufify still scans everything Android has indexed.
folders.removeNote: Removing a folder stops re-indexing it. Your tracks stay.
folders.ignoreShortHint: Skips anything under 30 seconds. Off by default: interludes and album segues are real tracks.

shuffle.title: Shuffle
shuffle.label: Algorithm
shuffle.pureHint: Truly random. It will sometimes play the same artist twice in a row, because that is what random does.
shuffle.balancedHint: Spreads each artist across the queue, so no two of their tracks land together.
shuffle.discoveryHint: Favours what you have played least. An unplayed track comes up twice as often as one you have heard once.
shuffle.favoritesHint: The opposite of Discovery: favours what you play most, and pushes anything you have hearted further up.
shuffle.albumHint: Shuffles the albums, not the tracks. Each album plays through in order — for classical and anything with a running order.

playback.title: Playback
playback.hapticsHint: A short buzz on play, pause, queueing and reordering.

motion.title: Motion
motion.speedHint: How quickly panels arrive. Instant skips the movement entirely.

player.title: Now playing
player.empty: Nothing playing. Pick a track from the library.

queue.empty: Nothing queued. Play something from the library.
